description: FX Settlement Corridor Intelligence — per-pair execution risk assessment for 10 major currency corridors against USD (EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, MXN, BRL, CNY, INR). Maps live FRED spot rates to settlement advice per pair: SETTLE_NOW / SETTLE_WITH_HEDGE / DELAY_SHORT / DELAY_REVIEW / AVOID. Returns DXY dollar regime, regional block risk rollup, best/worst corridors, and recommended actions. 1h cache.
name: market.fx
